items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Today I do Hannon once in a while, but I never bothered when I was young, when I was young, to help get some fingers more quickly.

ctx.x: Let’s go back to the time at Mills College, how you learned and studied then. What was your practice regimen then? How did you practice the piano? What did you do during those years or before to develop? Did you play though scales and Hannon? Or did you just improvise? What would you do?
Nothing that [ ] classical good pianist. Today I do Hannon once in a while, but I never bothered when I should have, when I was young, to help get some fingers more quickly.
Did you do any scales back then, Cherney, or any of these exercises?
